text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "The system covers 10,700 square metres and generates around 750,000kWh of solar power for the ewb grid every year.", "gist": "A solar power system produces 750,000 kWh annually over 10,700 m²."}, {"type": "number", "quote": "10,700 square metres", "gist": "Area of the solar power system"}, {"type": "number", "quote": "750,000kWh", "gist": "Annual solar power generation"}, {"type": "number", "quote": "6,600", "gist": "Number of photovoltaic panels"}, {"type": "number", "quote": "812kWp", "gist": "Installed capacity of the photovoltaic panels"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "ewb", "gist": "Local energy supply company"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Insolight from Renens (VS)", "gist": "Company that developed the panels"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Reech AG from Landquart in Graubünden", "gist": "Company that developed the panels"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "The panels are transparent, so that 20 per cent of the sunlight can be used to produce electricity and 80 per cent is left for the plants in the greenhouse.", "gist": "Panels allow 20% sunlight for electricity and 80% for greenhouse plants."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "This guarantees a double 'harvest'.", "gist": "System enables simultaneous energy and plant production."}, {"type": "other", "quote": "“Energy-efficient mobility” category", "gist": "Project category classification"}]}
